newsitem.title: USA: Analog Devices sees Q4 revs, net flat vs Q3.
newsitem.headline: Analog Devices sees Q4 revs, net flat vs Q3.

text.p: Analog Devices Inc's president said the company expects fourth quarter revenues and earnings to be about flat with the third quarter's.
In Anolog's third quarter, which ended August 3, its revenues were $305 million and its earnings $0.35 a share.

"Our guidance for Q4 is (we will) maintan revenues and earnings at Q3 levels" president and chief operating officer Jerald Fishman told the Montgomery Securities Investment Conference here. Fishman added that if fourth quarter earnings met the third quarter's, that would result in EPS growth of 35 percent year over year.
